Display scale changed while the editor is open (real WM_DPICHANGED)

evidence.note: AGain itself supports content scaling. This run uses the helper's acceptance switch (APEX_VST3_EDITOR_TEST_MODE=no-content-scale) so the host takes the path it takes for a plug-in WITHOUT IPlugViewContentScaleSupport. The display scale, the window and the plug-in view are real; a third-party plug-in that genuinely lacks the interface was not available.

cases.title: Fixed-size (non-resizable) editor across a real DPI change

evidence.note: AGain reports canResize() == true. This run uses APEX_VST3_EDITOR_TEST_MODE=fixed-size so the host treats it as a non-resizable editor (no sizing border, min/max pinned) while the display scale really changes.
